question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product of Two Vectors Whose Angle Is a Special Angle
question.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $5$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $3,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${90}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =5\cdot 3\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{90}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =15\cdot 1\cdot n \\  & =15n.\end{aligned}
$$
